purpose: Test whether visual reconstruction quality predicts physical accuracy under a second held-out interaction, and whether additional observations resolve task-relevant ambiguity.

previous_release.name: gap-first-v01
previous_release.scope_correction: Native ReconPhys drop plus our stem and bowl controls do not complete the requested recent-method cross-framework benchmark. The failed PhysTwin spring-core bowl adapter is not evidence of native PhysTwin failure.

benchmark: PhysGaia is a dataset/benchmark, not a prediction method.

published_evidence_not_our_reproduction.location: Ablation, convex vertices K=6 versus K=8
published_evidence_not_our_reproduction.interpretation: Within this ablation, higher reconstruction PSNR does not select the better physical estimate or future prediction. It does not establish universal method failure.
Published parameter identification errors; new paired rendering and interaction measurements remain required.
Authors state that material and external forces are not explicitly disentangled and assume uniform gravity. This is a stated scope limitation, not our measured failure.
Strong changed-interaction comparison; estimated contact motion is imposed through velocity boundary conditions. Force-controlled prediction must not receive the resulting indentation as input.

experiment_contract.qualification: Reproduce each supported native setting first. Pin code, checkpoints, units, camera, preprocessing, and input evidence. Report adaptations separately. Unsupported scenarios are not failures.
experiment_contract.fit: Use an observation prefix only. Separate known geometry/density/force/controller assumptions explicitly for every method.
experiment_contract.freeze: Freeze each model's task prediction and our model-specific predicted risk before revealing the outcome.
experiment_contract.correct: Supply identical additional view or calibrated interaction evidence to ordinary refitting and uncertainty-aware approaches. Select evidence without access to the true hidden world.
experiment_contract.test: Predict a second, different held-out interaction from a reset state. Neither its trajectory nor indentation is input under force control.
render_metrics: LPIPS on cameras with recorded ground truth
uncertainty_metrics: Brier score for frozen model failure
controls: predictable repeated action despite parameter ambiguity
point estimator with identical corrective evidence
experiment_contract.claim: Good rendering alone cannot certify action-relevant physics under insufficient observations. Do not claim rendering and accurate simulation can never coexist.
